scripts.typecheck: pnpm catalog:prepare && astro check && tsc --noEmit -p src/worker/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: pnpm typecheck && astro build && node scripts/remove-static-catalog.mjs
scripts.predeploy:check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.worker:dev: node scripts/prepare-wrangler-config.mjs --environment local && wrangler dev --config wrangler.generated.local.jsonc
scripts.worker:deploy:preview: node scripts/check-cloudflare-env.mjs --environment preview && node scripts/prepare-wrangler-config.mjs --environment preview && pnpm catalog:prepare && wrangler d1 migrations apply shou-food-preview --remote --config wrangler.generated.preview.jsonc && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.generated.preview.jsonc
scripts.worker:deploy:production: node scripts/check-cloudflare-env.mjs --environment production && node scripts/prepare-wrangler-config.mjs --environment production && pnpm catalog:prepare && wrangler d1 migrations apply shou-food --remote --config wrangler.generated.production.jsonc && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.generated.production.jsonc
scripts.d1:migrate:local: node scripts/prepare-wrangler-config.mjs --environment local && wrangler d1 migrations apply shou-food --local --config wrangler.generated.local.jsonc
scripts.d1:migrate:preview: node scripts/check-cloudflare-env.mjs --environment preview && node scripts/prepare-wrangler-config.mjs --environment preview && wrangler d1 migrations apply shou-food-preview --remote --config wrangler.generated.preview.jsonc
scripts.d1:migrate:production: node scripts/check-cloudflare-env.mjs --environment production && node scripts/prepare-wrangler-config.mjs --environment production && wrangler d1 migrations apply shou-food --remote --config wrangler.generated.production.jsonc
